name: College Hockey America
notes: lineage: the CHA's women's division (2002-03 on; the CHA was women-only from 2010-11) merged with the men-only Atlantic Hockey Association as Atlantic Hockey America from 2024-25 with the same six members, so one id spans both, as ncaa_mhockey:atlantic-hockey does on the men's side (USCHO's id changes from 1 to 22)

notes: women's hockey was sponsored by the ECAC itself until the 2007 ECAC Hockey rebrand gave both divisions one name; USCHO keeps one id across it

notes: 2001-02 only: USCHO's 'ECAC Eastern' group of eight eastern schools, six of which started Hockey East's women's league the next season

notes: 2000-01 and 2001-02: Findlay, Mercyhurst and Wayne State, who formed the CHA's women's division in 2002-03

notes: the women's WCHA continued after the men's league ended in 2020-21
